note: The current allowance of the role lint (TESTPLAN DD-T14), keyed (file, pattern) with the count still allowed. `count` may only shrink: it must be <= role-baseline.json in every worktree, and equal to the actual hit count with CONVERGENCE=1, so a removed hit forces a lower count. `rows` are the docs/visual-contract.md rows the hits belong to (each hit's function, selector or file must be named by one of them); `owner` is the slice that removes the last hit and must own at least one of the rows. K deletes an entry whose count reaches zero.
